Veritas Finance Limited has filed its DRHP with SEBI to raise up to ₹900 crore to strengthen its capital base and support future lending growth.

With a strong focus on MSME financing, Veritas Finance has built its business by serving entrepreneurs and small businesses that often have limited access to formal credit.

It reflects the growing confidence in specialised NBFCs with strong business models and disciplined lending practices.

As NBFCs grow, capital becomes important.
But long-term success depends on trust.

Trust is built through strong governance, healthy asset quality, effective risk management, and consistent regulatory compliance.

As more NBFCs look to the public markets for growth capital, these fundamentals will become even more important.

Planning to set up, acquire, scale, or raise capital for an NBFC? Connect with our team. We help NBFCs with RBI compliance, governance, financial structuring, due diligence, and strategic advisory.
